lines.t: Together in One Place
October 20th, 2023
From Yahushua Hamashiach, Our Lord and Saviour
The Word of the Lord spoken to Timothy
For those in Discord Fellowship
See, I have gathered you together in one place once again,
according to my will, and in accord with my servant's willingness
to see to your further edification,
to the nurturing of that which has sprouted within you.
and according to the one among you who asked. Thus those of you who wish to see with new eyes
and restored vision shall indeed see, and those of you who long to hear shall indeed hear.
For it is time, it is time to ask, it is time to listen with all attentiveness, and know that I am
he, he who sees, yes, he who knows. For it is not my will that one of you be left, that not one of
you falter before the time, rather it is my will that you rise up in me, even as I shall arise in
you, that I may gather you to myself, that you may be with me, where I am, always, yet you must
choose. Therefore again I say to you, ask, and it shall surely be given you. Eat, and be satisfied,
for I am with you. Yes, even to the end of this age, which is upon you. Yes, my beloved ones,
the time has come, the day is here. Therefore prepare and make ready, even deep within your
hearts, for the great day has indeed come. It is time for the Father to glorify his name
once again, as in the days of old, to strike fear into the hearts of all nations, to cause
his name to resound in all the earth, to lead a great multitude to repentance, before the
time, says the Lord Yahushua.
